name: researching-plugin
description: Route research tasks into literature discovery, project-local PDF records, evidence synthesis, cross-disciplinary research briefs, human-supervised direction selection, and optional authorized planning or execution workflows.

interface.longDescription: Routes research tasks to focused literature discovery, project-local PDF decomposition and Markdown records, evidence grounding, cross-disciplinary concept and capability mapping, research-route comparison, human decision checkpoints, and optional separately authorized planning or execution.
defaultPrompt: Use the researching workflow to find papers for my current task.
Find a paper, save its authorized PDF in my research folder, and create a Markdown record.
Turn my rough question into a research brief with feasible routes and a human decision checkpoint.
